body:
RTL is definitely not correct to use here, it has nothing to do with alignment, and only control how segments of bidirectional text are sorted. See https://www.w3.org/International/articles/inline-bidi-markup/uba-basics#context

Clipping from the left can be done using by drawing glyphs directly, ellipsis on the beginning is not supported, and will require changes to `TextServer` (should be relatively easy to add).
